ordering_rule: A phase may begin only after every listed dependency has a PASS test receipt and a verified manifest. Dependencies point only to earlier phases. This matrix intentionally contains no output hashes, receipts, manifests, or predicted artifact digests.

phases.purpose: Freeze this preregistration and phase graph.
Validate canonical JSON, receipt, and manifest runtime wiring.
Verify exact 15:20 source custody and leading-zero symbols.
Build chronological causal training and validation partitions without fresh OOS.
Validate fixed-notional ten-slot accounting at 23bp and 0/46bp controls.
Define and validate action masks for cash, slot, duplicate, and missing-bar constraints.
Exercise environment wiring on synthetic fixtures only.
Specify frozen baselines and shuffled-label control contracts.
Run bounded historical plumbing smoke only after separate approval.
Review smoke integrity, not model quality or promotion.
Run preregistered validation experiments with identical configuration seeds.
Evaluate frozen validation comparisons and controls.
Record a validation stop, NO_GO, or separate eligibility decision.
Prepare an independently approved fresh-OOS custody gate; do not access OOS.
One-time fresh-OOS evaluation only under a separate approved gate.
Reconcile OOS results, controls, uncertainty, and manifests.
Record research verdict; failure remains NO_GO or INCONCLUSIVE.
Archive immutable research evidence; this is not a live-trading authorization.
